title: Unveiling Language Routing Isolation in Multilingual MoE Models for Interpretable Subnetwork Adaptation
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical mechanisms of expert routing in multilingual Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models to improve performance in low-resource languages. Although a qualitative case study involves a question about a mythological figure (Karna), the paper's core research does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics.
